answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The wharf is the quoted measurement, the trellis the group it forms, and the tundra the voice that group is worth; the wharf and the trellis collapse a farm, while only a fresh tundra of hardware escapes the grouping.
